title: New website lets Koreans rate police investigations like restaurants
caption:
South Korea's new 'Police Map' website allows citizens to post reviews and ratings of police stations. The platform aims to document professional conduct and build trust through firsthand accounts of investigations.

Source: Koreaherald - New website lets Koreans rate police investigations like restaurants

https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10927603
